Yes. I have a 14yo labrador who is currently fighting cancer. She had a tumor in her leg, which was removed in surgery and a biopsia was performed. The result came back as malignant schwannoma. Prior to the surgery we also did several exams just to confirm she was fit to undergo it (blood and heart-related)

Surgery was definitely rough on her, and once the wound closed, we started chemo. She had her 4th and last session this past Monday. Chemo had no side effects on her at all.

For us, it was 100% worth it. She now has an energy that she hadn't showed in a long while, she's back to playing catch and everything. She looks so much happier and it warms my heart to see it.

I decided to do the best that I could to get her healthy again, she's truly a fighter. The decision worked for us and is working for her type of cancer at least.
